items.briefing:
Ransomware attackers are now using AI tools to move faster than ever, meaning organisations have less time to detect and respond to an attack before serious damage is done. This is a direct concern for Australian training organisations, which hold sensitive student and staff data that can be attractive targets. Separately, a vulnerability called "Certighost" has been found in Microsoft Active Directory certificate services, which could allow attackers to gain elevated access to systems — check with your IT support to ensure patches are applied promptly.

**Practical tip:** Make sure your data backups are tested regularly and stored somewhere separate from your main network, so you can recover quickly if ransomware strikes.

featured.title: Ransomware attacks speed up as hackers use AI tools
featured.quote: AI-accelerated ransomware attacks targeting Australian manufacturers represent a direct, evolving threat to critical industry.
